title: Python foundations
description: Brackenridge Mountain Rescue is a team of volunteers, and its callout log, kit lists and rota live in a notebook and a spreadsheet nobody trusts. You have never written a line of code, and you start there: make the laptop at the base print, count, store and check what the team needs, and learn to read what Python says when something is wrong. Then you teach it to decide and repeat, with if, for and while, and to reuse your work in functions of your own. Each issue teaches one part of Python in one small program you run yourself in a real terminal.
